newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Record low coupon for Portugal 3-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Record low coupon for Portugal 3-yr bond.

text.p: The coupon on the Portuguese state's new series of three-year bonds was expected to be set at a record low of between 5.375 and 5.50 percent, analysts and dealers said.
The result of the auction for 25 billion escudos of the March 2000 bonds (OT), the first of the new series announced by the Institute for Public Credit Management, will be released at 1100 GMT.
Traders said that demand was good for the paper, with most of the bids between 5.40 and 5.50 percent.
The coupon for the series will be set at the weighted average yield at Tuesday's sale, rounded up to the nearest 0.125 percent.
The nearest equivalent paper, the February 2000, rose 80 basis points to 117.84 escudos, a record high, on Monday, with a yield of 5.45 percent.

Analysts said that the sharp gains in the Spanish market, together with the easing in the one-year Portuguese Treasury bill rates on Monday, expectations for further Portuguese rate cuts, perhaps even this month, and the strength of the escudo pointed to demand well in excess of offer at the Monday bond sale.
"This is a new benchmark and everybody wants to have this paper in their portfolios," said one analyst at an investment bank.
Another factor helping the auction was the excess of liquidity in the system, traders and analysts said.
